mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 73 degrees. Look to the west over Mount Horeb at 9:54 PM to spot the International Space Station for one minute. The moon is a Waning Crescent, and we expect an overnight low of 69 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The Verona Fire Department invites you to their open house on September 19 from 10 AM to 2 PM at 101 Lincoln Street. It is a great chance to tour the station, meet the firefighters, and learn about fire safety.

There is plenty to do in our city. Today, join us for trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, check out the Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza night at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department received information regarding an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student from 2019. This led to the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison on a charge of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.
Today's flavor is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently open, but they will be closing in 52 minutes, so make sure to get your scoop before they wrap up for the night.
